instruction.name: xvffint.d.lu
instruction.description: Convert unsigned 64-bit integer elements in `a` to double-precision floating point numbers.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvffint.d.lu $xr0, $xr8; xvffint.d.lu $xr1, $xr9; xvffint.d.lu $xr2, $xr10; xvffint.d.lu $xr3, $xr11; xvffint.d.lu $xr4, $xr12; xvffint.d.lu $xr5, $xr13; xvffint.d.lu $xr6, $xr14; xvffint.d.lu $xr7, $xr15
